So your telling me that China's capitalist free market attracted all the Bitcoin mining hardware?

Its not their market that attached the investments. China has a lot of areas with subsidized or near free electricity. The biggest expense in running mining equipment is electricity. If you can mine with no electricity cost you can run really inefficient rigs and still eek out a profit since all of your investment was in the purchasing of equipment, rent and salaries.

To give a bit more reference, I get electricity to my home for about 7 cents a KWh, which is crazy cheap in the US, when I was running a low end, low power rig, I was still paying around $50 a month extra in electricity. The rig would mine about $50 worth of bitcoin at the difficulty level at that time. So I was breaking even on just power but was not covering the cost of the rig or my time that I spent keeping the system running. I wish that it was more complicated like America is turning into a socialist fascist crazy land, which might be true, but in this case it really boils down to electricity.
